Banking / Cost analysis

Why did bank deposit
costs fall?

Across 4,018 screened banks, quarterly deposit interest expense fell by $5.01 billion. The analysis separates changes in balances, interest-bearing mix and a derived rate measure.

A finance team can use the breakdown to frame a pricing review before making assumptions about customer behavior.

Investment underwriting / Report estimates + assumptions

Can the sales estimate support the development budget? ↗

Labor economics / Public data

When does a pay rise buy more? ↗

Real hourly earnings rose 2.1% from February 2020, but fell 0.7% in the latest twelve months. Explore the roles of inflation and weekly hours.

Operations / Public data + assumptions

How much fuel-price risk should a budget carry? ↗

A historical reserve covered 20 of 26 quarters. A fixed 10% buffer covered 24. See where the smaller reserve fell short.

A little about me

Economics at Houston.
Questions across industries.

I earned my B.S. in Economics at the University of Houston, with a minor in Entrepreneurship. My coursework included economic data analysis, behavioral economics, money and banking, and energy economics.

Those interests carry into my projects. I work through financial disclosures, compare lending markets and test operational forecasts. I’m looking for an analyst role where I can develop that work with a team and help explain the findings to the people making decisions.
